priorityList.notes: Potion at the top of the fight if mana is already below 75 percent, or a mana gem below 60 percent, saved for the closing burn if the fight is nearly over.
Life Tap to keep casting once mana runs low; health is not a concern with three DoTs and Drain Life available.
Bane of Agony ramps up over its duration, so it goes down first and is refreshed on cooldown.
Corruption is the cheapest DoT per damage and is kept up throughout.

Wrack is live (sim/warlock/wrack.go, talent-gated, RequiredLevel 40): an instant, no-cooldown 6 second DoT that also applies a +10% Shadow-damage-taken vulnerability to the target, so it is refreshed the moment it drops rather than waiting behind the longer Bane of Agony/Corruption timers above it. The level-60 ladder golden confirms high uptime and it as the spec's #2 damage source behind Shadow Bolt.
Shadow Bolt fills every remaining global while the DoTs run their course.

Shoot (5019, core.RegisterShootSpell) is the wand-weaving fallback added by the rotation-accuracy program's caster-wand finding (2026-09-28): sim/warlock never enabled a ranged auto attack or registered a Shoot action, so a leveling warlock's equipped wand dealt zero damage even though the ladder harness always equips one. Placed beneath Life Tap's own 10 percent gate above and gated below 20 percent mana itself, so Life Tap keeps first claim on refueling mana with health and Shoot only fills the band above that where Shadow Bolt is no longer affordable. Warlocks have no Wand Specialization equivalent, so this casts at the wand's plain damage.
